headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense. In a close contest, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0 behind Chase Burns' strong pitching performance. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels) and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (Toronto Blue Jays) being placed on the injured list. Abner Uribe (Milwaukee Brewers), Colt Emerson (Seattle Mariners), Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox), Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants), Trevor McDonald (San Francisco Giants), and Garrett Whitlock (Boston Red Sox) also suffered injuries.

Several trades and roster movements occurred, including Jonathan Ornelas being traded from the Athletics to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, and the Kansas City Royals received Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, unable to overcome the Cubs' strong performance. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Burns led the Reds' pitching effort, throwing 7.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all made significant contributions to the White Sox's victory.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players contributing to the win. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto were among the impact hitters, while Michael McGreevy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their roster with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
